Download App Get Started for Free

The National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS) has released the EMRS Tier 2 Result for the post of Junior Secretariat Assistant and Principal under Phase 2 and Phase 1 respectively. The result has been released on the official website, i.e. nests.tribal.gov.in and examinationservices.nic.in. Candidates can download the EMRS Result and check their qualifying status. Shortlisted candidates can prepare for document verification and interview rounds. Check the full details of the Eklavya Model Residential Schools Tier 2 Result PDF link, scorecard, cut-off, steps, dates, login details & more in the below article.

EMRS Tier 2 exams were held from 22nd March to 25th March, 2026 to fill 7,267 teaching & non-teaching posts across Eklavya Model Residential Schools. Out of over 5 lakh applicants who filled out the form in which around 1.2 lakh approximately appeared for the exam. The EMRS result 2026 has been officially released now on 03 September 2026 @nests.tribal.gov.in. The results for remaining teaching/non-teaching posts will be released in phases.

Latest Updates 

The National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS) has released the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 on its official website @nests.tribal.gov.in.

The EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 download link has been activated for the Principal and JSA.

EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 Out @nests.tribal.gov.in

The National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS) has released the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 @nests.tribal.gov.in. Candidates who appeared in the exams from 22nd March to 25th March, 2026 can check the status on the official website. The recruitment covers 7,267 vacancies across teaching & non-teaching positions like Principal, PGT, TGT, Hostel Warden and Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA).

EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 OUT Official Notice

The publication of the Eklavya Model Residential Schools Result 2026 brings relief to thousands of exam givers. NESTS released the provisional answer key earlier & accepted the challenges till 17th May, 2026. After evaluating the objections the scores are finalised & compiled the selection list. Candidates who get the qualifying marks will move on to the document verification or interview rounds. Checking the EMRS Tier 2 2026 Result helps to confirm the score breakdown, total cutoff marks & merit status of the candidates

EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 PDF Download Link Active @nests.tribal.gov.in

The EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 PDF Download Link is active now @nests.tribal.gov.in after the official declaration of the result. Candidates can see the status of who qualified & download the merit lists. The merit list shows the roll numbers of candidates who are shortlisted along with the qualifying status for the Document Verification & interview rounds. Candidates should click on the official EMRS result 2026 PDF Link to access the complete post-wise list of qualified candidates.

How to Download EMRS Tier 2 2026 Result?

Candidates can download the EMRS 2026 Result from the official website directly. NESTS publishes the selection list in PDF form. The format allows users to review the qualification status on computers or smartphones. Follow the below steps given for EMRS result 2026 download link

  1. Go to the official website @nests.tribal.gov.in
  2. Click on the tab of “Recruitment” on the homepage
  3. Select the link named “EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 PDF Download Link”
  4. Open the PDF file & search for the Roll No. using Ctrl + F
  5. Download the file to the device & take a printout for the records

EMRS Tier 2 Cut Off 2026 Subject/Category Wise

The cutoff marks show the minimum score needed in the selection process. NESTS determines the cutoffs based on total vacancies, performance & difficulty level of the exam. Reviewing cutoff scores with the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 helps to confirm the qualification rank of the candidates

Category Expected Qualifying Cutoff (%) Overall Score Range
General / Unreserved (UR) 68% – 74% 82 – 90 Marks
Economically Weaker Section (EWS) 62% – 67% 75 – 81 Marks
Other Backward Classes (OBC) 63% – 68% 76 – 82 Marks
Scheduled Caste (SC) 55% – 60% 66 – 72 Marks
Scheduled Tribe (ST) 52% – 57% 62 – 68 Marks
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) 45% – 50% 54 – 60 Marks

What Are EMRS Tier 2 Qualifying Standards?

The qualifying standards set the baseline percentage needed to pass the exam. NESTS establishes this to select candidates for teaching & staff roles. Candidates must meet the criteria to stay eligible for the final merit list

  • Sectional Performance: Candidates must get pass marks in subject knowledge topics
  • Language Test : English & Hindi tests need minimum qualifying marks
  • Negative Marking: Every incorrect answer cuts 0.25 marks of the candidates
  • Category Relaxations : Candidates in reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC, PwBD gets pass mark relaxations

EMRS Tier 2 Score Card 2026 Download Link

The EMRS Tier 2 Score card is an official performance certificate issued by NESTS that tells about section wise scores, total marks & qualification status of the candidates. Those who qualify the exam must save a copy of the scorecard for the upcoming Document Verification phase & interviews. They can access the official EMRS result 2026 download link @nests.tribal.gov.in & log in with the application details to view the marks before the document verification round of the candidates.

What Details Are Mentioned on EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026?

Candidates should carefully check all information printed on the scorecard or  EMRS merit list 2026 PDF. If a candidate notices any errors, contact the official helpdesk right away. The EMRS Tier 2 Result login details are as under

  • Full Name of the Candidates
  • Roll Number & Registration ID
  • Applied Post (e.g., TGT, PGT, Principal, Hostel Warden)
  • Category (UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS)
  • Marks Obtained in EMRS 2026 Result for Tier 2
  • Qualifying Status (Qualified / Not Qualified)
  • Post-wise & Category-wise Cutoff Marks

What Next After EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026?

Candidates who pass the Tier 2 exam move forward to Document Verification (DV). Those applying for the Principal post must also attend a personal interview round. Collect original copies of the documents for verification

  • Identity Proof: Aadhar Card, PAN Card or Voter ID
  • Educational Documents : Class 10th & 12th marksheets, Degree certificates & Post Graduation transcripts
  • Professional Certificates: B.Ed. degree or relevant teaching diplomas
  • Category Certificates : Valid caste or category certificates issued by authorized officials
  • Exam Records: Copies of the Tier 2 Admit Card & saved EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 page

EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 Student Queries

Ques. What is the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 date?

Ans. The official EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 date of release is 03 and 05 August 2026.

Ques. Where can the candidates check the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 ?

Ans. They can access the EMRS Tier 2 2026 Result directly @nests.tribal.gov.in.

Ques. Do the candidates need login details to download the EMRS Tier 2 merit list PDF?

Ans. No the EMRS merit list 2026 PDF opens directly on the website allowing to search for the roll number using Ctrl + F without logging in

Ques. Is there an interview stage after the EMRS Tier 2 exam?

Ans. Interviews apply only to posts like Principal. Selection for TGT, PGT, Hostel Warden & JSA depending on written exam scores & document verification of the candidates

Ques. How are tie scores resolved in the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 ?

Ans. In EMRS 2026 Result If 2 candidates get equal marks NESTS uses tie breaking rules like age, seniority or higher scores in papers to decide the final rank
